headline: Bajel Projects secures a ₹1,500 crore order for Gujarat green energy transmission
hook: Largest single contract win for Bajel Projects
summary: Bajel Projects has bagged a record ₹1,500 crore order from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation to develop transmission infrastructure for the state's green energy corridor. The project involves constructing high-voltage power transmission lines to evacuate renewable energy. This is the company's largest single contract win to date, significantly boosting its order book. Indian retail investors tracking power transmission and capital goods companies should note the impact on the company's future revenue visibility.
whats_next: Quarterly financial results reflecting order execution progress
why_it_matters: Order book expansion boosts future revenue visibility for Bajel Projects.

summary: Bajel Projects shares surged 12.3% to an intraday high of ₹175.30. The stock opened at ₹171.90, significantly higher than its previous close of ₹156.15. The rally follows a period of price movement for the power infrastructure company.
why_it_matters: Sudden price volatility may impact short-term trading positions in the stock.

headline: Bajel Projects bags its largest-ever ₹1,500 crore transmission order in Gujarat
hook: Record order expands grid capacity in Gujarat
summary: Bajel Projects has secured a ₹1,500 crore contract from Lakadia A Power Transmission Ltd to build 270 km of 765 kV transmission lines and substation works in Gujarat. The 36-month project will facilitate the evacuation of roughly 14 GW of renewable energy from Lakadia, Jam Khambhaliya, and Jamnagar. This win marks the single largest order in the company's history, significantly boosting its order book. Retail investors in power infrastructure plays should track execution speed over the next three years.
whats_next: Project execution updates over the 36-month timeline
why_it_matters: Order book expands significantly with major renewable evacuation contract.
